## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical skills in delivering static content on AWS with basic IaC, health checks, and rollback.

- S3 static hosting with versioning
- CloudFront with Origin Access Identity
- Health checks and rollback strategy
- Minimal CloudFormation

## Code Example
```yaml
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Resources:
  SPABucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
  CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentity:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::OriginAccessIdentity
    Properties:
      CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentityConfig:
        Comment: Access for SPA
  Distribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Origins:
          - DomainName: !GetAtt SPAExample.BucketDomainName
            Id: s3Origin
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: !Join ['', ['origin-access-identity/cloudfront/', !Ref CloudFrontOriginAccessIdentity]]
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates practical knowledge of serverless canary deployments and rollback strategies using familiar AWS services, including Lambda aliases, API Gateway, CodePipeline, and CloudWatch—without the complexity of container orchestration.

## Key Concepts
- Lambda versions and aliases (v1, v2) for immutable deployment snapshots
- Canary traffic shifting via API Gateway stage variables
- CloudWatch alarms for monitoring error rates and triggering auto-rollback
- Minimal CloudFormation setup for Lambda aliases and API Gateway integration
- Testing plan and rollback procedures for production safety

## Code Example
```yaml
Resources:
  MyFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: my-serverless-api
      Runtime: python3.9
      Handler: index.handler
      CodeUri: ./src
  MyFunctionV1Alias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MyFunction
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt MyFunction.Version
      Name: v1
  MyFunctionV2Alias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MyFunction
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt MyFunction.Version
      Name: v2
      RoutingConfig:
        AdditionalVersionWeights:
          - FunctionVersion: !GetAtt MyFunction.Version
            FunctionWeight: 0.1
```
